# Week 4 Start/Sit Briefing -- Monday, 2026-09-28

## Source and freshness

**Live, in-house only.** `nflreadpy` (schedules, rosters, player stats, depth charts) run end-to-end through `generate_report.py`'s in-house tier at 2026-09-28T06:19Z. ESPN, Sleeper and Rotowire are all proxy-blocked in this sandbox and FantasyPros has no key here, so every number below is the repo's own fitted model, not a vendor consensus. There is also **no usable committed Week 4 fixture** -- the one checked into the repo (`weekly-report-week-4.json`) was generated 2026-09-08, before the season had even kicked off, so it could not be used as a cross-check or a fallback.

**Jaxson Dart is done for the season.** He suffered multi-ligament knee damage (MCL/PCL/meniscus) and had season-ending surgery, confirmed in the Week 3 fixture (2026-09-23) and repeated in the last two briefings. Nothing in this run's live pull can re-confirm that on its own -- a player who's already out for the year simply stops generating new reports -- so it's carried forward by hand rather than re-derived. Treat this as the one fact in this briefing that wasn't freshly verified today, though there is no reason to think it changed.

## Start these ten (Week 4)

| Slot | Player | Opp | Expected pts | P(play) | If he plays |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| QB | Matthew Stafford | @PHI (Sun) | **16.12** | 96.2% | 16.76 |
| RB | Jonathan Taylor | @WAS (Sun) | **18.25** | 94.0% | 19.43 |
| RB | Bucky Irving | vs GB (Sun) | **13.72** | 94.0% | 14.60 |
| WR | Jaxon Smith-Njigba | vs LAC (Sun) | **22.06** | 95.9% | 23.00 |
| WR | Drake London | @NO (Mon) | **15.35** | 95.9% | 16.00 |
| TE | Isaiah Likely | vs ARI (Sun) | **12.71** | 93.4% | 13.61 |
| FLEX | Brock Bowers | vs KC (Sun) | **15.47** | 80.1% | 19.33 |
| FLEX | Tee Higgins | vs JAX (Sun) | **14.10** | 95.9% | 14.70 |
| K | Cameron Dicker | @SEA (Sun) | **5.39** | 98.1% | 5.49 |
| DEF | Eagles D/ST | vs LA (Sun) | **4.73** | 100% | 4.73 |

**Lineup total: 137.9 expected points.**

Eight of ten are clean calls. The one real decision this week is the second FLEX spot:

- **Bowers (15.47 expected) vs. Higgins (14.10 expected).** Bowers' raw upside (19.33 if he plays) is the best number on the bench, and the model's 80.1% play probability already discounts for his injury history -- so the expected-points math favors him by about 1.4 points. But he's been designated Out, Doubtful, and Questionable in Weeks 1, 2, and 3 respectively (an improving trend, not a clean bill of health), and **no Week 4 report exists for anyone yet** -- first practice reports post Wednesday. If you want the safer lineup, start Higgins; you give up ~1.4 expected points for a much more certain floor. Recommend re-checking Wednesday before it matters.

## Changes

- **Bowers into the flex for the first time this season**, over Downs, on pure expected value (see above) -- low confidence, re-check Wednesday.
- **Dart still needs to go to IR.** This isn't new -- it's been true since Week 3 -- but roster.json still lists him as the starting QB and he hasn't been moved, which means a roster spot that could be a streaming QB or bye-week insurance is sitting dead. See waiver targets below.

## Watch list

| Player | Why | News due |
|---|---|---|
| Brock Bowers | Out -> Doubtful -> Questionable across Weeks 1-3; currently started ahead of Higgins on expected value | Wed 10/1 practice report |
| Jaxson Dart | Season-ending, not yet moved to IR -- wasted roster spot | Action item, not news |

## Opponent notes

- **Stafford vs. the Eagles D/ST is the same game** (LA @ PHI, Sunday). They're on opposite sides -- a big Eagles defensive day caps Stafford's ceiling and vice versa. Don't expect both to hit their number.
- **London plays the Monday-nighter** (ATL @ NO) -- last game of the week. His flex/WR slot is locked in here regardless, but it's the one score that settles after everything else.

## Byes ahead

- **Week 6:** Tee Higgins (CIN) and Jameson Williams (DET) -- both bench/flex-caliber WRs out the same week. With only 5 bench spots, this is worth planning a waiver add for now rather than waiting.
- **Week 7:** Cameron Dicker (LAC) -- the only rostered kicker. Plan a one-week streaming kicker pickup.

## Waiver / roster-construction priority (before Wednesday)

1. **Drop Dart, add a backup QB.** The roster currently has zero QB depth behind Stafford. Streaming candidates by this model's own projection this week (availability on your specific wire unverified): Josh Allen, Tyler Shough, Brock Purdy, Bryce Young, Jared Goff all project ahead of Stafford, but in an 8-team league most starters are likely already rostered elsewhere -- check the wire directly.
2. **Plan ahead for the Week 6 WR bye cluster** (Higgins + Williams). Malik Washington (MIA WR) is this model's top currently-projected free-agent-caliber add (10.59 expected pts, 3 games of early-season data) -- an early, unproven sample, but worth a speculative claim now rather than scrambling in Week 6.
3. Kicker streaming for Dicker's Week 7 bye can wait until closer to that week.

## Caveats

- No live source in this sandbox reached ESPN, Sleeper, Rotowire, or FantasyPros; every number here is the in-house model only, and there was no usable committed Week 4 fixture to check it against.
- Dart's season-ending status is carried forward by hand, not freshly re-confirmed by this run.
- The Bowers-over-Higgins flex call is genuinely close and could flip on Wednesday's first practice report.
- Waiver-wire availability could not be verified against the other seven rosters in this league.
